title: Valid Anagram
prompt: Given two strings s and t, return true if t is an anagram of s, and false otherwise. An Anagram is a word or phrase formed by rearranging the letters of a different word or phrase, typically using all the original letters exactly once.
constraints: s and t consist of lowercase English letters.
hints: An anagram has the same character counts. Two approaches: sort both strings and compare, or use a hash map to count characters.
For the hash map approach: count each character in s, then decrement for each character in t. If any count goes negative or doesn't exist, it's not an anagram.
You can use a single array of 26 integers (one per letter) instead of a hash map for a clean O(1) space approach.
Time: O(n), Space: O(1) with character count array.
